text: State that the system is an LLM/AI prediction model and name the clinical task it addresses.
Provide a structured summary covering objective, data, methods, evaluation, and limitations.
Explain the clinical background and rationale for developing or applying the model.
State the specific objectives, intended use, and target deployment context.
Describe the data sources used for development and evaluation, with dates and provenance.
Describe eligibility criteria and the population the evaluation data represent.
Justify the number of evaluation items and its adequacy for the claims made.
Describe the human oversight and clinician-in-the-loop safeguards around model use.
Report overall performance and discrimination metrics on the evaluation set.
Report a calibration measure relating predicted scores to observed outcomes.
Report performance across clinically relevant subgroups to surface fairness gaps.
Report the compute, token usage, or monetary cost of running the evaluation.
Discuss limitations, failure modes, and risks that bound safe use.
State availability of the model, code, prompts, and evaluation data for scrutiny.
